evidence: Exports connectWebSocket(port) returning { send, waitForMessage, waitForChannel, waitForResponse, getMessages, close }
send() sends WebSocketRequest with _tag, id, method, body
waitForMessage() accepts predicate function with 30s default timeout
waitForChannel() waits for WsPush on specific channel
waitForResponse() waits for WebSocketSuccess/WebSocketError matching request ID
unpackMessage() handles WsPush unpacking for server.bootstrap, workflow.snapshot, workflow.event, repl.output
Smoke test exercises WebSocket connection via browser (second test: 'WebSocket connection establishes')
